JABVOX_BULK_WA.TITLE: Bulk WhatsApp
JABVOX_BULK_WA.SUBTITLE: Send WhatsApp template messages to many contacts at once from a CSV file.

LEADS.SELECT_INBOX_FIRST: Select an inbox to choose how the message is sent.
LEADS.NO_TEMPLATES: This inbox has no approved templates.

SEND.INBOX_PLACEHOLDER: Select the inbox to send from
SEND.SENDER_HINT: A temporary token (valid 30 min) is created for this user so n8n can send on their behalf. It expires automatically.
SEND.REPORT_EMAIL_HINT: Required. The send result will be emailed here.
SEND.FILE_HINT: Columns: nombre, numero, template, idioma. For official WhatsApp the 'template' column is the approved template name; for API inboxes it is the plain message text.
SEND.SAMPLE_HINT: Not sure about the format? Select an inbox and download a sample CSV.
SEND.SAMPLE_SELECT_INBOX: Select an inbox first to download the sample.
SEND.CONFIG_REQUIRED_BODY: Set the webhook URL and the response email in Settings before sending a bulk message.
SEND.MISSING_HEADERS: Missing columns: {cols}. Required: nombre, numero, template, idioma.
SEND.ERROR: Could not send. Check the file and the webhook settings.

SETTINGS.WEBHOOK_HINT: The parsed CSV, the account id, the inbox id and the sender's API token are POSTed here.
SETTINGS.RESPONSE_EMAIL_HINT: The send result is reported to this address. Required to enable bulk sending.
